chunks: And my father narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Basri, and his nickname is Fahd, from some of his men, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The clay of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) is a cure for every disease.
ai.seo_question: What is the healing significance of the clay from Imam Husayn's grave?
ai.summary: In *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Ibn Qulawayh records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) to establish the metaphysical potency of Turbat al-Husayn, linking the physical clay of the grave to divine healing (shifa). This tradition underscores the Shia belief that the burial sites of the Ahl al-Bayt serve as conduits for spiritual and physical cure, reflecting the broader theological concept of the Imam as the 'Proof of God' upon whom creation depends.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Ḥusain ibn Sa’īd, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān Al-Basri, from his father, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
The cure for every disease is in the clay of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) and it is the greatest medicine.
